observed.caption: People gather on a dry grassy hilltop with colorful paragliders on the ground and one in the air against a mountain backdrop.
observed.description: A wide outdoor hilltop covered in dry brown grass and patches of dirt slopes toward a rocky mountain peak in the background under an overcast sky. A colorful paraglider with red, yellow, and blue sections is airborne above the ridge, while several other paraglider canopies in white and purple, blue and green, and blue and orange lie on the ground. Scattered green trees and shrubs dot the hillside. Numerous people are spread across the hill, some sitting on the grass in the foreground and midground, some standing or walking, and some gathered in small groups near the canopies, with a small blue tent visible on the ridge.
